{{Quote|But, if you want to come into the village and meet people, so you can get on with your trading, my mother runs a tavern that's as good as place as any&hellip;|[[Flint]]|<ref name="Star Wars Annual (1977) 3">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 3|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 3]]</ref>}}
'''Zana's Tavern''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. It was run by [[Zana]], an older [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who had once had a relationship with a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Flint Torul]]. Locals would stop by the place to have a drink before their shifts at the [[Belderone AT-AT factory|factory]], and Zana was happy to accommodate them. Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] heroes, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] came to the tavern to try to discover clues about what the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] were doing on Belderone. During their stay, they were attacked by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Andrid]], but they were able to fend them off.

During the [[Battle of Belderone (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Belderone]], an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] broke loose from the battle, and rampaged through the city. The tavern was completely obliterated, and Zana was killed. Her son, [[Flint]] would discover her lifeless body among the wreckage of the tavern the next morning.
